name: Edge

glb_conventions.root_bone_rest: axis change (YOBJ -Y up/-Z forward -> glTF +Y up/+Z forward, i.e. 180deg about X) + hip height; all other joints keep the exact YOBJ local frames
glb_conventions.bone_local_rotation: quaternion of R = Rz(rz)*Ry(ry)*Rx(rx) from 'rotate' (Blender Euler 'XYZ')

notes: 0_10000.yobj: its own bind skeleton differs from the body's (max |dM| 0.348); vertices kept as stored (they line up with the body) and bound to the body bones
0_20000.yobj: its own bind skeleton differs from the body's (max |dM| 0.348); vertices kept as stored (they line up with the body) and bound to the body bones
in-game body scale 1.0210 from chEtc.pac record 110 ('EDGE', +0x20 = 4182/4096); height_m = height_units * units_to_m * ingame_scale (model_height_m is the raw, height-normalised model).
Bind pose is the game's A-pose (arms ~15deg below horizontal, legs ~15deg apart).
Body texture 'color' alpha is a specular/gloss mask (body materials are OPAQUE); hair/eyelash cards (mesh flag 0x100) use it as coverage -> alphaMode MASK, double-sided.
Normal maps are the game's tangent-space maps with the green channel flipped (D3D -> glTF).
Hands use their own textures (BloodHand0_L/_R = clean hand skin, blood level 0).
